ps1.4:3.2: Imāni pañc' indriyāni paṇṇarasahi ākārehi visujjhanti.

ps1.4:3.5: kusīte puggale parivajjayato āraddhaviriye puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato sammappadhāne paccavekkhato
ps1.4:3.7: muṭṭhassati puggale parivajjayato upaṭṭhitassati puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato satipaṭṭhāne paccavekkhato
ps1.4:3.9: asamāhite puggale parivajjayato samāhite puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato jhānavimokkhe paccavekkhato
ps1.4:3.11: duppaññe puggale parivajjayato paññavante puggale sevato bhajato payirupāsato gambhīrañāṇacariyaṃ paccavekkhato

ps1.4:3.14: imehi paṇṇarasahi ākārehi imāni pañc' indriyāni visujjhanti.
ps1.4:4.1: Paṭis_I,IV.3: Katih' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāviyanti? Katih' ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvanā hoti?
ps1.4:4.2: Dasah' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāviyanti, dasah' ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvanā hoti.
ps1.4:4.3: Assaddhiyaṃ pajahanto saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti, saddhindriyaṃ bhāvento assaddhiyaṃ pajahati;
ps1.4:4.4: kosajjaṃ pajahanto viriyindriyaṃ bhāveti, viriyindriyaṃ bhāvento kosajjaṃ pajahati;
ps1.4:4.5: pamādaṃ pajahanto satindriyaṃ bhāveti, satindriyaṃ bhāvento pamādaṃ pajahati;
ps1.4:4.6: uddhaccaṃ pajahanto samādhindriyaṃ bhāveti, samādhindriyaṃ bhāvento uddhaccaṃ pajahati;
ps1.4:4.7: avijjaṃ pajahanto paññindriyaṃ bhāveti, paññindriyaṃ bhāvento avijjaṃ pajahati.
ps1.4:4.8: Imehi dasah' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāviyanti, imehi dasah' ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvanā hoti.
ps1.4:5.1: Paṭis_I,IV.4: Katih' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni?
ps1.4:5.2: Dasah' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.
ps1.4:5.3: Assaddhiyassa pahīnattā suppahīnattā saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti subhāvitaṃ,
ps1.4:5.4: assaddhiyassa bhāvitattā subhāvitattā assaddhiyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti suppahīnaṃ;
ps1.4:5.7: pamādassa pahīnattā suppahīnattā satindriyaṃ . . . pe . . . hoti suppahīnam;
ps1.4:5.11: avijjāya pahīnattā suppahīnattā paññindriyaṃ . . . pe . . . hoti suppahīnaṃ.
ps1.4:5.13: Imehi dasah' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.
ps1.4:6.1: Paṭis_I,IV.5: Katih' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāviyanti? Katih' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāvitāni c' eva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭipassaddhāni ca suppaṭipassaddhāni ca?
ps1.4:6.2: Catūh' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāviyanti, catūh' ākārehi pañc' indriyāni bhāvitāni c' eva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭipassaddhāni ca suppaṭipassaddhāni ca.

ps1.4:6.10: Arahattaphalakkhaṇe pañc' indriyāni bhāvitāni c' eva honti subhāvitāni ca paṭipassaddhāni ca suppaṭipassaddhāni ca.
ps1.4:6.11: Iti catasso maggavisuddhiyo, catasso phalavisuddhiyo, catasso samucchedavisuddhiyo, catasso paṭipassaddhivisuddhiyo.

ps1.4:13.1: Katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayo hoti?
ps1.4:13.2: Katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayaṃ pajānāti?
ps1.4:13.3: Adhimokkhatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, adhimokkhavasena chandassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, saddhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.4: Paggahatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena chandassa samudayo viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa samudayo viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, viriyindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.5: Upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ satindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.6: Avikkhepatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena chandassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.7: Dassanatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena chandassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.8: Adhimokkhatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanatthāya āvajjanāya samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.9: Adhimokkhavasena chandassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena chandassa samudayo viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena chandassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena chandassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.10: Adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa samudayo saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa samudayo viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa samudayo satindriyassa samudayo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa samudayo samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa samudayo paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.
ps1.4:13.11: Saddhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ saddhindriyassa samudayo hoti, viriyindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ viriyindriyassa samudayo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ satindriyassa samudayo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ samādhindriyassa samudayo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattupaṭṭhānaṃ paññindriyassa samudayo hoti.

ps1.4:15.2: Katamehi cattārīsāya ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ atthaṅgamaṃ pajānāti?

ps1.4:15.5: Upaṭṭhānatthāya āvajjanāya atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena chandassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattaṃ anupaṭṭhānaṃ satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:16.3: Adhimokkhavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paggahavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo viriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, upaṭṭhānavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, avikkhepavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, dassanavasena manasikārassa atthaṅgamo paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.
ps1.4:16.4: Saddhindriyassa vasena ekattaṃ anupaṭṭhānaṃ saddhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, viriyindriyassa vasena ekattaṃ anupaṭṭhānaṃ viriyindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, satindriyassa vasena ekattaṃ anupaṭṭhānaṃ satindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, samādhindriyassa vasena ekattaṃ anupaṭṭhānaṃ. samādhindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti, paññindriyassa vasena ekattaṃ anupaṭṭhānaṃ paññindriyassa atthaṅgamo hoti.

ps1.4:54.6: Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu saddhindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā. Paṭis_I,IV.23:
ps1.4:55.1: Catūsu sammappadhānesu viriyindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?
ps1.4:55.2: Anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya sammappadhāne paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena viriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, viriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā;
ps1.4:55.3: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya sammappadhāne . . . pe . . .
ps1.4:55.4: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya sammappakhāne . . . pe . . .
ps1.4:55.5: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā sammappadhāne paggahādhipateyyaṭṭhena viriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, viriyindriyassa vasena upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.
ps1.4:55.6: Catūsu sammappadhānesu viriyindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā. Paṭis_I,IV.24:
ps1.4:56.1: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?
ps1.4:56.2: Kāye kāyānupassanā satipaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . paggahaṭṭhena viriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā;
ps1.4:56.5: dhammesu dhammānupassanāsatipaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhānādhipateyyaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, satindriyassa vasena avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . paggahaṭṭhena viriyindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.
ps1.4:56.6: Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu satindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā. Paṭis_I,IV.25:
ps1.4:57.1: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?
ps1.4:57.2: Paṭhamajjhāne avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā;
ps1.4:57.5: avikkhepādhipateyyaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, samādhindriyassa vasena dassanaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.
ps1.4:57.6: Catūsu jhānesu samādhindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā. Paṭis_I,IV.26:
ps1.4:58.1: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā?
ps1.4:58.2: Dukkhe ariyasacce dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā;
ps1.4:58.5: dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasacce dassanādhipateyyaṭṭhena paññindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā, paññindriyassa vasena adhimokkhaṭṭhena saddhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā . . . pe . . . avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhindriyassa cariyā daṭṭhabbā.
ps1.4:58.6: Catūsu ariyasaccesu paññindriyassa vasena imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ cariyā daṭṭhabbā. Paṭis_I,IV.27:
ps1.4:59.1: Cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti paṭividdho, yathā carantaṃ yathā viharantaṃ viññū sabrahmacārī gambhīresu ṭhānesu okappeyyuṃ,
ps1.4:59.2: addhā ayaṃ āyasmā patto vā pāpuṇissati vā.
ps1.4:60.2: iriyāpathacariyā, āyatanacariyā, saticariyā, samādhicariyā, ñāṇacariyā, maggacariyā, patticariyā, lokuttaracariyā.
ps1.4:60.10: ‘Lokuttaracariyā' ti. Tathāgatesu Arahantesu Sammāsambuddhesu padesapaccekabuddhesu padesasāvakesu.
ps1.4:60.11: Iriyāpathacariyā ca paṇidhisampannānaṃ, āyatanacariyā ca indriyesu guttadvārānaṃ, saticariyā ca appamādavihārīnaṃ, samādhicariyā ca adhicittamanuyuttānaṃ, ñāṇacariyā ca buddhisampannānaṃ, maggacariyā ca sammāpaṭipannāmaṃ, patticariyā ca adhigataphalānaṃ, lokuttaracariyā ca Tathāgatānaṃ Arahantānaṃ Sammāsambuddhānaṃ padesapaccekabuddhānaṃ padesasāvakānaṃ.
ps1.4:61.2: Adhimuccanto saddhāya carati, paggaṇhanto viriyena carati, upaṭṭhāpento satiyā carati, avikkhepaṃ karonto samādhinā carati, pajānanto paññāya carati, vijānanto viññāṇacariyāya carati. ‘Evaṃ paṭipanno visesaṃ adhigacchatīti' visesacariyāya carati, ‘evaṃ paṭipannassa kusalā dhammā āyāpentīti' āyatanacariyāya carati.
ps1.4:62.2: Dassanacariyā ca sammādiṭṭhiyā, abhiropanacariyā ca sammāsaṅkappassa, pariggahacariyā ca sammāvācāya, samuṭṭhānacariyā ca sammākammantassa, vodānacariyā ca sammā-ājīvassa, paggahacariyā ca sammāvāyāmassa, upaṭṭhānacariyā ca sammāsatiyā, avikkhepacariyā ca sammāsamādhissa.
ps1.4:63.1: Paṭis_I,IV.28: ‘Vihāro' ti. Adhimuccanto saddhāya viharati, paggaṇhanto viriyena viharati, upaṭṭhāpento satiyā viharati, avikkhepaṃ karonto samādhinā viharati, pajānanto paññāya viharati.
ps1.4:64.1: ‘Anubuddho' ti Saddhindriyassa adhimokkhaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, viriyindriyassa paggahaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, satindriyassa upaṭṭhānaṭṭho anubuddho hoti, samādhindriyassa avikkhepaṭṭho anubuddho hoti. paññindriyassa dassanaṭṭho anubuddho hoti.
ps1.4:65.1: ‘Paṭividdho' ti Saddhindriyassa adhimokkhaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, viriyindriyassa paggahaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, satindriyassa upaṭṭhānaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, samādhindriyassa avikkhepaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti, paññindriyassa dassanaṭṭho paṭividdho hoti.
ps1.4:65.2: ‘Yathā carantan' ti. Evaṃ saddhāya carantaṃ, evaṃ viriyena carantaṃ, evaṃ satiyā carantaṃ, evaṃ samādhinā carantaṃ, evaṃ paññāya carantaṃ.
ps1.4:65.3: ‘Yathā viharantan' ti. Evaṃ saddhāya viharantaṃ, evaṃ viriyena viharantaṃ, evaṃ satiyā viharantaṃ, evaṃ samādhinā viharantaṃ, evaṃ paññāya viharantaṃ.
ps1.4:65.4: ‘Viññū' ti. Viññū vibhāvī medhāvī paṇḍitā buddhisampannā.
ps1.4:65.6: ‘Gambhīresu ṭhānesūti'. Gambhīrāni ṭhānāni vuccanti jhānāni ca vimokkhā ca samādhī ca samāpattiyo ca maggā ca phalāni ca abhiññāyo ca paṭisambhidā ca.
ps1.4:65.8: ‘Addhā' ti Ekaṃsavacanaṃ etaṃ, nissaṃsayavacanaṃ etaṃ, nikkaṅkhavacanaṃ etaṃ, advejjhavacanaṃ etaṃ, adveḷhakavacanaṃ etaṃ, niyogavacanaṃ etaṃ, apaṇṇakavacanaṃ etaṃ, avatthāpanavacanaṃ etaṃ
ps1.4:65.10: ‘Āyasmā' ti. Piyavacanaṃ etaṃ, garuvacanaṃ etaṃ, sagāravasappatissādhivacanaṃ
